summary: Mesoblast filed a Form 6-K attaching an ASX press release announcing receipt of a BLA filing number from the FDA for rexlemestrocel-L in end-stage heart failure patients with LVADs, and a request for modular review. No financial terms, stake, premium, or board recommendation are provided. The filing is a routine regulatory update about a BLA submission and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any special-situation transaction. It is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing business progress.
